page.overview:
Who is Alman II?

Emperor Alman II was the ninth Emperor of the Known Universe (r. 184–206 AG). He was the son of seventh emperor, Alman I, and presumably usurped the throne from Saudir II Negara II.

Alman II was the son of Alman I (r. 104–123 AG). Alman I was succeeded in 123 by the previously exiled Saudir II Negara II of the original Saluso Corrino line.

Alman II succeeded Saudir II as emperor in 184, Shortly after his accession, Alman II murdered Demetrios IV Atreides, son of Elias Atreides (a known supporter of Saudir II), and had the Atreides lands redistributed.

Alman II ruled until 206, when he was succeeded by his son Alman III.
